content:
<thought>We have retrieved polymorphs for the first five oxide compositions and listed their JSON files. To meet the requirement (up to 40 oxides, max_energy_above_hull = 0.3, max_per_composition = 3), we will now retrieve polymorphs for the remaining 31 oxide formulas in a single batch, saving them to the same “oxides_data” directory. After that we will consolidate all generated JSON files into one dataset and return its path.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "ZnO","MgO","CaO","SrO","BaO","CoO","NiO","MnO","Cr2O3","V2O5",
        "MoO3","WO3","PbO","PbO2","SnO2","Bi2O3","Ti3O5","ZrO2","HfO2",
        "Nb2O5","Ta2O5","La2O3","CeO2","Nd2O3","Sm2O3","Gd2O3","Y2O3",
        "Sc2O3","Ti2O3","GeO2","In2O3"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "oxides_data"
}
